boot.documentation-overview: This project involves porting specific components of a diffuse scattering simulation from NumPy to PyTorch, focusing on gradient flow capabilities. The documentation consists of several interrelated files detailing the architecture, implementation plan, specifications, and progress tracking.

document.description: Definitive list of components that need to be ported to PyTorch.
High-level overview of the implementation plan, system boundaries, and architecture.
Detailed phase-by-phase implementation plan with tasks, dependencies, and timelines.
Detailed component descriptions, interactions, and implementation guidelines.
Implementation specifications with low-level task details.
Implementation progress tracking with function-by-function status.
Original debugging script with run_np() function that generates ground truth data.
Main codebase directory containing original NumPy implementation and stub files for PyTorch port.

bootstrap-instructions.instruction: 1. Review the documents in the order specified in the review-process section. 2. Pay special attention to the definitive scope in to_convert.json. 3. Understand the system boundaries between NumPy and PyTorch parts in plan.md. 4. Study the component interactions in architecture.md. 5. Review the phased implementation plan in phased_plan.md. 6. Check the current implementation status in progress.md. 7. For implementation tasks, refer to the detailed specifications in specs/spec1.md. 8. When reviewing code, first check the original implementation, then the PyTorch stubs. 9. Note that ground truth data is available in logs/ directory but not directly accessible in the provided files. 10. Compare implementation state in source files with documentation (particularly progress.md) to ensure consistency.

scenario.condition: One or more functions have been implemented or their status has changed

step.action: Update progress.md with the new implementation status
step.details: - Update the function status in the appropriate phase section - Update the "Tests" column if tests have been implemented - Add any relevant notes about challenges or design decisions - Update the completion percentage for the affected phase - Update the overall completion percentage - Update the checkpoint status if a checkpoint has been reached - Add an entry to the update history section

step.action: Check if any checkpoint has been completed
step.details: - If a checkpoint has been completed, update the checkpoint status in progress.md - Update the "Date Completed" field

step.action: Update the "Current Focus" and "Next Steps" sections in progress.md
step.details: - Reflect the next implementation priorities based on the phased_plan.md - Update blockers and challenges if any have been identified
- For completed components, add performance comparisons with NumPy - Include memory usage and execution time metrics

scenario.condition: Changes to implementation plan, architecture, or specifications

step.action: Update the source document (plan.md, architecture.md, phased_plan.md, or specs/spec1.md)
step.details: - Make changes to the relevant document first - Ensure internal consistency within the document - Update version or date information if applicable
- Use the document-relationships section to identify affected documents - Check documents that reference the changed document - Check documents that detail the changed document

- For plan.md changes, update phased_plan.md, architecture.md, and specs/spec1.md - For architecture.md changes, update specs/spec1.md - For phased_plan.md changes, update progress.md - Ensure all cross-references remain valid
- Ensure all changes still align with the defined scope in to_convert.json - If scope has changed, update to_convert.json first

step.action: Update progress.md if implementation tasks have changed
step.details: - Add or remove functions from the tracking tables - Update timeline if schedule has changed - Add an entry to the update history section

scenario.condition: Changes to the components that need to be ported (to_convert.json)

step.details: - Add or remove functions as needed - Ensure the format is consistent
- Update the Function Mapping Table - Adjust system boundaries if needed - Update call structure analysis if new components are added
- Update the Component-to-Function Mapping table - Modify the component interaction diagram - Add or remove component descriptions - Update data flows
- Update the Function-to-Task Mapping table - Add or remove implementation tasks - Adjust timeline and dependencies - Update Component-to-Test Mapping
- Update the Function-to-Task Mapping - Modify Low-Level Tasks - Update Implementation Validation Strategy
- Add or remove functions from tracking tables - Adjust completion percentages - Update timeline - Add an entry to the update history section

scenario.condition: Periodic check or after multiple changes

step.details: - Ensure all documents accurately reflect the components in to_convert.json - Check for any mentions of components not in scope
- Verify all document cross-references are correct - Check links between documents - Ensure references to specific sections are valid
- Ensure progress.md accurately reflects the actual implementation state - Verify all functions from to_convert.json are being tracked - Check completion percentages
- Adjust implementation timelines in phased_plan.md if needed - Update the development timeline in progress.md

scenario.condition: Need to create a new detailed specification document for a component or phase

step.action: Determine the scope and purpose of the new specification document
step.details: - Identify which component(s) or phase(s) need detailed specifications - Determine if it's for a specific implementation phase, component group, or specialized aspect - Ensure it aligns with components in to_convert.json

- Use specs/spec1.md as a template for structure and formatting - Create file with naming convention: specs/spec[number].md - Include Document References and Relationships section - Include High-Level Objective, Mid-Level Objectives - Include Implementation Notes - Add Function-to-Task Mapping relevant to this spec - Include Low-Level Tasks with detailed implementation steps - Add Implementation Validation Strategy - Include Final Verification Checklist
- Add the new spec document to the document-relationships section - Define its relationships with other documents - Update review-process section if needed

step.action: Update plan.md and phased_plan.md to reference the new spec
step.details: - Add references to the new spec document in relevant sections - Ensure cross-references are consistent
- If the spec introduces new tasks or reorganizes existing ones, update progress tracking - Add a note about the new specification document in the update history

step.action: Verify consistency with other specification documents
step.details: - Ensure no overlap or contradictions with existing spec documents - Make clear the boundaries between different spec documents - Check for consistent terminology across all spec documents

scenario.condition: Implementation state (source files) does not match documentation

step.action: Identify discrepancies between implementation and documentation
step.details: - Compare implemented functions with progress.md - Check if implementation approaches match architecture.md - Verify stub files exist for all components in to_convert.json - Check that directory structure matches plan.md

step.action: Update progress.md to reflect actual implementation state
step.details: - Update function status (Not Started/In Progress/Complete) - Update phase completion percentages - Update checkpoint status - Add an entry to the update history section

step.action: Update other documentation if implementation deviates from plan
step.details: - If implementation approach differs from architecture.md, update it - If phase ordering has changed, update phased_plan.md - If scope has changed, update to_convert.json

update-instructions.instruction: 1. Identify which update scenario applies based on the changes made. 2. Follow the step-by-step process for that scenario. 3. If multiple scenarios apply, start with the most fundamental (scope changes first, then plan changes, then implementation progress). 4. After applying the specific scenario process, perform a consistency check (Scenario 4). 5. When updating documents: - Maintain the same formatting and structure - Update section numbers and references as needed - Preserve cross-references between documents - Ensure tables are properly aligned - Keep document tone and style consistent 6. Document all changes made in the update history section of progress.md. 7. When creating new specification documents, follow Scenario 5 process and ensure proper integration with existing documentation. 8. If implementation state doesn't match documentation, apply Scenario 6 process to bring them into alignment.
